title: Messages to Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea

questions.question: And to the angel of the church in Sardis write... "I know your works. You have the reputation of being ____, but you are dead."
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:1 (ESV): "And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: ...'I know your works. You have the reputation of being alive, but you are dead.'"

questions.question: Wake up, and strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have not found your ____ complete in the sight of my God.
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:2 (ESV): "Wake up, and strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have not found your works complete in the sight of my God."

questions.question: Yet you have still a few names in Sardis, people who have not soiled their ____, and they will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:4 (ESV): "Yet you have still a few names in Sardis, people who have not soiled their garments, and they will walk with me in white, for they are worthy."

questions.question: The one who conquers will be clothed thus in white garments, and I will never blot his name out of the book of ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:5 (ESV): "The one who conquers will be clothed thus in white garments, and I will never blot his name out of the book of life. I will confess his name before my Father and before his angels."

questions.question: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: "The words of the holy one, the true one, who has the key of ____, who opens and no one will shut, who shuts and no one opens."
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:7 (ESV): "And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: 'The words of the holy one, the true one, who has the key of David, who opens and no one will shut, who shuts and no one opens.'"

questions.question: I know your works. Behold, I have set before you an open ____, which no one is able to shut.
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:8 (ESV): "I know your works. Behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one is able to shut. I know that you have but little power, and yet you have kept my word and have not denied my name."

questions.question: Because you have kept my word about patient endurance, I will keep you from the hour of ____ that is coming on the whole world, to try those who dwell on the earth.
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:10 (ESV): "Because you have kept my word about patient endurance, I will keep you from the hour of trial that is coming on the whole world, to try those who dwell on the earth."

questions.question: I am coming soon. Hold fast what you have, so that no one may seize your ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:11 (ESV): "I am coming soon. Hold fast what you have, so that no one may seize your crown."

questions.question: The one who conquers, I will make him a ____ in the temple of my God. Never shall he go out of it...
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:12 (ESV): "The one who conquers, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God. Never shall he go out of it, and I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down from my God out of heaven, and my own new name."

questions.question: And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write... "I know your works: you are neither cold nor ____."
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:14-15 (ESV): "And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write: ...'I know your works: you are neither cold nor hot. Would that you were either cold or hot!'"

questions.question: So, because you are ____, and neither hot nor cold, I will spit you out of my mouth.
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:16 (ESV): "So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spit you out of my mouth."

questions.question: For you say, I am ____, I have prospered, and I need nothing, not realizing that you are wretched, pitiable, poor, blind, and naked.
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:17 (ESV): "For you say, I am rich, I have prospered, and I need nothing, not realizing that you are wretched, pitiable, poor, blind, and naked."

questions.question: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, so that you may be rich, and white garments so that you may clothe yourself... and salve to anoint your ____, so that you may see.
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:18 (ESV): "I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, so that you may be rich, and white garments so that you may clothe yourself and the shame of your nakedness may not be seen, and salve to anoint your eyes, so that you may see."

questions.question: Those whom I love, I ____ and discipline, so be zealous and repent.
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:19 (ESV): "Those whom I love, I reprove and discipline, so be zealous and repent."

questions.question: Behold, I stand at the door and ____. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat with him, and he with me.
questions.explanation: Revelation 3:20 (ESV): "Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat with him, and he with me."

key_verse_text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat with him, and he with me.
